title: My macro-enabled Excel report won't open due to a 'Trust Center' warning
description: My financial model file contains macros and the macros get blocked every time it opens.

worklogs.description: The file had the 'Mark of the Web' attribute, did Properties > Unblock.
Reviewed the user's Trusted Locations list, added the OneDrive folder.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: The file had MOTW because it came from the internet. I removed it and added a Trusted Location — the macros will work now.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: The macros worked, my model is usable again. Thanks.

resolutionNote: Removed the file's 'Mark of the Web' and added the user folder to Excel Trusted Locations.

csat.comment: They explained the issue in detail, so I'll know it in the future too.
